content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Data Analysis and its Importance
    - Lesson 2: Understanding Datasets and Types of Data
    - Lesson 3: Basic Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 4: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Python Libraries: NumPy and Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing with Pandas
    - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis using Pandas and Matplotlib

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: SQL JOIN Operations
    - Lesson 4: Filtering Data with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 5: GROUP BY and Aggregate Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Complex Queries
    - Lesson 7: Creating, Altering, and Deleting Tables
    - Lesson 8: Advanced SQL Techniques (UNION, OUTER JOIN)

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 1)
    - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
    - Lesson 2: Creating Bar Graphs and Histograms in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 3: Scatter Plots, Box Plots, and Heatmaps
    - Lesson 4: Customizing and Styling Matplotlib Plots
    - Lesson 5: Intro to Seaborn for Data Visualization
    - Lesson 6: Seaborn Line Plots and Regression Plots
    - Lesson 7: Seaborn Boxplots, Heatmaps, and Cluster Maps
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques with Seaborn

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 2)
    - Lesson 1: Intro to Bokeh for Interactive Plots
    - Lesson 2: Creating Interactive Line Charts in Bokeh
    - Lesson 3: Building Interactive Bar Graphs and Scatter Plots
    - Lesson 4: Customizing and Styling Bokeh Plots
    - Lesson 5: Intro to Dash for Building Dashboards
    - Lesson 6: Creating Basic Dashboards with Dash
    - Lesson 7: Adding Interactivity to Your Dashboards with Dash
    - Lesson 8: Building Complete Interactive Dashboards with Dash and Plotly

   Track: Machine Learning Fundamentals (Part 1)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Machine Learning
    - Lesson 2: Supervised Learning vs Unsupervised Learning
    - Lesson 3: Regression Analysis and Linear Regression
    - Lesson 4: Classification Algorithms: Logistic Regression
    - Lesson 5: Clustering Algorithms: K-means Clustering
    - Lesson 6: Evaluating Machine Learning Models
    - Lesson 7: Tuning Hyperparameters with Grid Search
    - Lesson 8: Ensemble Methods: Bagging and Boosting

   Track: Machine Learning Fundamentals (Part 2)
    - Lesson 1: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques: PCA
    - Lesson 2: Overfitting, Underfitting, and Regularization
    - Lesson 3: Neural Networks: Perceptron and Multilayer Perceptrons
    - Lesson 4: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for Images
    - Lesson 5: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) for Time Series Data
    - Lesson 6: Reinforcement Learning and Q-Learning
    - Lesson 7: Deep Learning with Keras and TensorFlow
    - Lesson 8: Applying Machine Learning to Real-World Projects
